description: Eawag publishes photographs taken during the floodX urban flash-flood experiments at Wangen, Switzerland. The deposit contains a TAR archive of flooding images and a readme describing shifts between camera timestamps and the experiment reference time. Unlike several other floodX packages, these photographs are licensed CC-BY-4.0, with free public access subject to attribution. Their spatial coverage follows the experiment viewpoints; exact dates, camera resolution and sampling intervals are not specified in the landing-page summary. A limitation is that timestamp corrections and changing viewpoints must be handled before images are paired with simulated states. The photographs can provide qualitative checks of flood extent and support development of image-based observation methods. They complement the separately deposited surveillance videos and instrument series, not supplying a measured water-depth raster. No image archive was downloaded and no accuracy assessment was performed.
